title: Gerrymandering Metrics
format: typst

### 2024 Election Results and the 2024 District Map

```{r}
precinct_clean <- g24_sov_by_g24_svprec |>
  mutate(
    district = paste0("CA-", str_pad(CDDIST, 2, pad = "0")),
    dem = as.numeric(DEMVOTE),
    rep = as.numeric(REPVOTE)
  ) |>
  select(district, dem, rep)

district_votes <- precinct_clean |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarize(
    dem = sum(dem, na.rm = TRUE),
    rep = sum(rep, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    total = dem + rep,
    dem_share = dem / total
  ) |>
  filter(total > 0)   

```

```{r}
mean_median <- mean(district_votes$dem_share, na.rm = TRUE) -
               median(district_votes$dem_share, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_median

```

```{r}
wasted_votes_safe <- function(vA, vB) {

  total <- vA + vB
  half  <- total / 2

  if (vA > vB) {
    tibble(wasted_A = vA - half,
           wasted_B = vB)
  } else {
    tibble(wasted_A = vA,
           wasted_B = vB - half)
  }
}

```

```{r}
waste_table <- district_votes |>
  rowwise() |>
  do(bind_cols(., wasted_votes_safe(.$dem, .$rep))) |>
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
efficiency_gap <- (sum(waste_table$wasted_B) - 
                   sum(waste_table$wasted_A)) /
                   sum(district_votes$total)

efficiency_gap

```

```{r}
tibble(
  metric = c("Mean–Median Score", "Efficiency Gap"),
  value = c(mean_median, efficiency_gap)
)

```
